Shadow-banning is when you're banned from the entire site. It can't be done for a single community, as far as I know.

There IS a catch to a shadow-ban, though: You can view everything on Reddit. You can log in just fine and everything would seem normal. However, no one can see any posts or comments you've made after being shadow-banned. In addition, you're not notified about being shadow-banned, and if you view your own profile while logged in then everything displays just fine.

Basically, It's the type of ban where you would never know you were banned unless someone told you or you randomly decided to view your own profile while logged out. Hi, like many of you I come from reddit. This site seems quite a bit better than reddit right now! But I suspect when/if more people come here we run into similar problems. Why don't we try some new ideas to counteract some of the major problems on reddit? Here my ideas!

  No usernames

Wouldn't it be much better if we completely got rid of usernames/profiles and adopted a chan style random identification. Your account would get an unique identification for every submission (or maincomment?) you comment in. Instead of numbers wo could maybe use different coloured shapes or something like this, because I find it hard do remember numbers. Like this it's still possible to follow arguments. There are no profile pages, so no comment history and no karmacount.

Advantages:

  • no upvoating just because someone is "famous"

  • no karmawhoring

  • people would probably discuss more freely

  • no biased downvoting because someone expressed something controversial somewhere else

  • better privacy if we trust voat.co

Disadvantages:

  • possibly less comments/content because people can't "earn" something

  No visible votes

Maybe we could even go a step further and not even show upvo(a)ts in the comment section and scrap downvotes altogether. The site would internally save the upvotes and show a mix of new and upvoted comments.

Advantages:

  • less hivemindesque comment sections

  • even less karmawhoring

  • motivation for people to post at a later time

  • no more invisibility for controversial comments

Disadvantages:

  • probably some drop in quality density in big comment sections

  Ignore instead of ban

I don't know how voat handels moderation, but I think it would be much better if every individual could just ignore certain other users subverse wide instead of mods being able to ban. Maybe every subverse could have it's own ignore list you could activate/deactivate to make the thing a bit more userfriendly. Also, instead of deleting submissions, mods would add the account to their subverse ignore list.

Advantages:

  • freedom of speach

Disadvantages:

  • interferes with privacy gained through my first idea (you could ignore someone, look where comments dissapear and then unban again)
